purpose: open-source project landscape for the code-agent training mainline; what exists, what to adopt, what to reference
notes: HF dataset page nvidia/polar-swegym-pi-qwen35-122b-a10b-trajectories timed out via proxy on 2026-09-10; its existence and license are documented inside the snapshotted polar.html paper - verify by download before use

items.name: polar
items.title: Polar: Agentic RL on Any Harness at Scale
items.takeaway: gateway-proxy token-faithful RL through arbitrary harnesses; deployment harness IS the training environment; Qwen3.5-4B + GRPO on SWE-Gym -> SWE-bench Verified 3.8->26.4% (Codex harness); open-sources ProRL-Agent-Server + 122B-teacher SWE-Gym trajectory dataset (tool-call format, Apache-2.0)

items.name: nemo_rl_swe_guide
items.title: NeMo RL two-stage SWE RL guide for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking
items.takeaway: Stage-1 'pivot': cheap single-step NO-sandbox RL teaching tool-call format via argument-matching rewards (23.6->30.4% pass@1); Stage-2 full agentic RL in sandbox (31.2%); no KL, clip 0.2/0.28; 24-node/192+ GPU scale; swe1.jsonl 50,661 pivot samples from expert trajectories

items.name: modal_rl_models
items.title: Best Open Source SWE/Coding-Agent Models Trained with RL
items.takeaway: landscape of 6 open RL-trained SWE models; OpenThinkerAgent-8B-RL = only fully published recipe (datasets+config+code+harness+weights+trajectories); DeepSWE = 64 H100 x 6 days

items.name: ares
items.title: ARES: open-source infrastructure for online RL on coding agents
items.takeaway: Gym-like async env framework, SWE-bench Verified eval ~20 min, Harbor task packs; NOT a trainer (RL integration = future work); eval infra candidate only

items.name: openpipe_art
items.title: OpenPipe ART (Agent Reinforcement Trainer)
items.takeaway: GRPO around any Python agent loop, modest hardware claim; no OPD, no SWE-bench-grade evidence

items.name: prorl_agent_server
items.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/ProRL-Agent-Server
items.takeaway: Polar's open gateway/server code (NeMo Gym environment); reference implementation for token-faithful trajectory reconstruction

items.name: openthoughts_agent_readme
items.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
items.takeaway: full open SFT->RL recipe at 8B/32B; SFT trajectories generated by GLM-4.7-AWQ teacher INSIDE the deployment harness (Terminus-2), >=5 model turns, 9,437-pair cold-start for RL; harness-aligned SFT = published instance of our option B
